author: john
title: Furry full-body commission wanted
content:
Looking to commission a furry artist!
Wanting a full-body of my cute gray-and-white wolf character (blue eyes, blue hoodie, friendly fluffy tail — ref ready).
Prefer clean/cute style with good lighting and expression.
Budget: $80–120
#furry #artcommission

author: Libertarian Parties of New Brunswick
title: Commission painted wooden sign (Fredericton)
content:
Libertarian Party of New Brunswick is looking to commission a local artist for a painted wooden sign, approximately 4x8.

We will pay for your time, pay for all your materials, you have artistic license to paint it how you want, we only care about the wording on it.

Fredericton-area-ish.
